metadata.description:
New Super Mario Land is a homebrew port of the Game Boy title Super Mario Land to the Super Famicom/Super Nintendo.
It features the aesthetics of the New Super Mario Bros series and a four player simultaneous multiplayer mode.

To commemorate the 30th anniversary of Super Mario Land, the game was given away on 30 Nintendo Power cartridges in 2019.

The version available here features vastly improved gameplay, performance and music (courtesy of Nikku4211, KungFuFurby, _aitchFactor and reflex) over that initial release.

Changelog:

v1.5:
-Fixed sprite glitches on certain SNES models (thanks to information from Near)

v1.4:
-Improved performance overall: less slowdown, less single frame drops

v1.3:
-Added new/improved music by Nikku4211, KungFuFurby, _aitchFactor, reflex
-Improved music player: added echo, 6-channel music, less clicks & pops
-Completely rewrote player handling, now more similar to Mario World including jump regrab
-Completely rewrote collision detection
-Added/improved player animations (Superball mode, super jump)
-Various bugfixes

v1.2:
-Improved player controls
-Various bugfixes

v1.1:
-Toned down player jump sound effects
-Various bugfixes

v1.0:
-Initial release
